assertions.title: Provider-aware file search stays pinned to the originating provider

steps.action: Enable File Search in compose tools and open upload menu
steps.expected: File-search upload can proceed and produce file records/query behavior to verify provider pinning
steps.observed: File Search toggle and upload menu render, but uploads fail with 403 temporary-ban

steps.action: Probe files API with authenticated seeded persona
steps.expected: Read/write access to file records for pinning verification
steps.observed: GET /api/files -> 403 temporary-ban; upload attempts report Axios 403 in browser console

assertions.issues: Could not complete upload + follow-up file-search query cycle to confirm provider-pinned backend reuse because seeded persona became temporarily banned.

assertions.title: Context-mode screenshots preserve both vision input and OCR text

steps.action: Attempt image upload from compose file menu
steps.expected: Image attaches and can be inspected for preserved image + OCR text behavior
steps.observed: Image upload attempts fail with 403 temporary-ban (browser console)

steps.expected: Attachment/transient state visible for OCR validation path
steps.observed: No successful attachment state; compose remains without uploaded image

evidence.consoleErrors: Failed to load resource: 403 + upload error AxiosError in customization-preservation/group-files-core/14-browser-console.txt

assertions.issues: Unable to validate stored OCR+image behavior because context-mode image upload was blocked by temporary-ban responses.

assertions.title: Native OpenAI, Azure, and Gemini tool routing keeps LibreChat file bookkeeping intact

steps.action: Run model-chat turns with file_search enabled (OpenAI then Gemini)
steps.expected: Request/trace evidence of native routing and coherent file bookkeeping without double ingestion
steps.observed: Turns are interrupted with ban-type failures (abort stream returns text {"type":"ban"})

steps.expected: Concrete route/request payload trace for native routing verification
steps.observed: agent-browser network capture returned no requests; console shows ban failures

evidence.consoleErrors: Abort stream error payload includes {"type":"ban"}; upload and resource requests 403 (14-browser-console.txt)
evidence.network: No captured requests from agent-browser network requests; fallback evidence in 14-browser-console.txt

assertions.issues: Could not verify native routing/file bookkeeping because seeded persona was in temporary-ban state and request-level capture was unavailable.

assertions.title: Audio and video transcription is an explicit compose-bar action that creates a dedicated transcript conversation

steps.action: Upload audio fixture from compose surface
steps.expected: Transcribe controls appear and allow explicit transcription action
steps.observed: Audio upload attempts fail with 403 temporary-ban; no transcribe action appears

steps.expected: POST /api/files/transcribe callable for dedicated transcript conversation flow

assertions.issues: Could not validate explicit Transcribe action and transcript-conversation creation because media upload/transcribe routes were blocked by temporary-ban.

assertions.title: Background transcription shows progress, completion, and failure in place

steps.action: Attempt to start a transcription job
steps.expected: Placeholder response enters processing and updates to completed/failed in place
steps.observed: No job can be queued because uploads/transcribe requests return 403 temporary-ban

steps.action: Inspect UI/console for background status events
steps.observed: No transcription placeholder/status lifecycle emitted in this run

assertions.issues: Background status lifecycle cannot be validated until transcription jobs can be created.

assertions.title: Diarization mode supports named speaker clips and disables prompts where unsupported

steps.action: Open Speech settings -> Advanced and select GPT-4o Diarize
steps.expected: Prompt editing disabled for diarization mode
steps.observed: Prompt field becomes disabled with helper text confirming diarized mode does not accept prompts

steps.action: Validate speaker-reference clip constraints and diarized transcript output via upload/transcribe
steps.expected: Named clip limits and duration/type validation enforce diarization rules; speaker-labeled transcript output rendered
steps.observed: Upload/transcribe routes blocked by temporary-ban (403), so clip-validation and output checks could not run

assertions.issues: Only prompt-disablement was confirmed; speaker-reference upload constraints and diarized output rendering remain blocked by temporary-ban responses.
